source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including all written/read and other notes, not normalized reconstructions.
source.public_versification_note: Public Judges 1–5 and Hebrew source references align one to one. All 145 original source records are bound exactly once.

key_decisions.decision: Keep the angel as speaker using divine first-person claims without supplying an identity explanation.
Preserve the sides image and snare while noting that thorns is supplied to complete the compressed Hebrew.
Use retrospective tense to mark the return to Joshua’s lifetime after the opening death notice.
Preserve the Heres form here rather than harmonizing Joshua’s Timnath-serah.
Keep the ancestral-gathering death image and both objects of the new generation’s lack of knowledge.
Retain divine giving and selling, both hand images and Israel’s inability to stand.
Keep divine agency in harm, oath and the people’s suffering without specifying only military departures.
Preserve the sexual infidelity metaphor and the contrast between generations.
Keep the LORD as rescuer and the emotional response to groaning under real oppression.
Retain the covenant charge and divine speech continuing into its consequence.
Keep the exact remaining-nations frame without converting it into a new universal conquest claim.
Preserve the test and third-person LORD within divine speech, clarifying the purpose.
